purpose: Optional credited examples of authored website geometry and scene interaction. These do not define the installing user’s identity or taste.
authorship: Nathan Hor supplied these sites as examples of his own work. Website source code and artwork are not included.

sites.evidence: Selected live browser views and navigation; no complete frame measurement or current-deployment audit.
visually_observed: A beige equipment chassis, portrait display, physical key rail, lamps, labels, and ruled typography form one hardware metaphor.
The Projects label is visible outside the left edge of its navigation key. An intermediate section change shows upper/lower shutter fields covering the content, followed by the project directory.
Run Diagnostic replaces the portrait display with a Snake diagnostic. Exiting shows a video-memory reconstruction state before the portrait returns.
transferable_principles: Make anatomy, text, state indicators, and transitions belong to one material story.
Let a component affect space outside its resting silhouette.
Choreograph the handoff between sections, including what conceals the content swap.
Use a physical metaphor as behavior, not a texture pasted over conventional components.
research_limits: Only selected live states were inspected.
Exact timings, full hover/exit curves, keyboard, touch and reduced-motion behavior are not established by these notes.

sites.evidence: Selected live browser views and navigation; no complete frame measurement or current-deployment audit.
visually_observed: A pale isometric city serves as the composition. Red pointers and detached labels identify locations; the product is part of that scene.
Selecting Introducing Quipus opens a device view with a left information panel, a large device model, and labels connected to hardware features.
Selecting Touchscreen changes its label to red, changes the selected control state, and replaces the panel's feature description. Back to city returns to the isometric overview.
transferable_principles: Treat the scene as a navigable product world, with components attached to meaningful places.
Coordinate object, selector, text, and context in response to one action.
Use pointer geometry and leader lines to connect controls to their subject.
Carry a distinctive visual logic through overview, detail, and return states.
research_limits: Only selected live states were inspected.
Exact timings, full hover/exit curves, keyboard, touch and reduced-motion behavior are not established by these notes.
